# gramlot-js-server 0.2.11

Connects the Gramlot component collections to the Node/Bun gallery and the standalone
Browser/Worker exporter. Grammar and browser modules travel together; directory and
single-file exports include the selected collections.

Requires the current Gramlot core and examples component releases. The three npm
packages retain a common version. Existing CLI commands remain unchanged.

Verified with workspace unit tests, Bun, Chromium/WebKit gallery interactions and
page startup across Node and serverless. No database integration is introduced.
